purpose: Empirical capability demand observed on current solver residuals. Rows diagnose what operation is missing or merely underdeployed; they do not authorize production behavior.

subject.population: WS2 admissible-order reserve-starvation frozen 40-parent confirmation sample

rows.minimalCounterfactual: Allow the already-existing admissible-order fallback more than the current 75M-node reserve while holding total production work fixed.
rows.demand: No new semantic reasoning is indicated by this evidence. Existing admissible-order capability can solve the parent in isolation at 179,026,618 nodes but is censored by its production reserve.

smallestProbe.question: Can a larger admissible-order reserve recover this recurring capability without displacing earlier-stage production solves at matched total work?
smallestProbe.advanceIf: A predeclared reserve fraction produces net referee-valid gains at matched total work with acceptable collateral.
smallestProbe.stopIf: Matched-work reallocation merely displaces earlier-stage winners or produces no net gains.

rows.notes: Paired recurrence evidence is R03270 under the same frozen confirmation probe.

subject.population: Lane-E exact DEAD/LIVE multi-pick divergence microscope

rows.minimalCounterfactual: At each exact divergence point, take the matched LIVE ordinary move instead of the causally fatal DEAD ordinary move.
rows.demand: Current hard facts and global accounting treat the matched moves alike, while the move changes path-resource occupancy and relational must-pass bounds. The candidate missing operation is a decision-bearing relation between local path-history/resource use and future obligation cost, not another global scalar counter.

smallestProbe.question: Does the same frozen path-resource plus relational-bound interface recur on independent exact DEAD/LIVE parents and distinguish causal divergences that current hard prunes do not?
smallestProbe.decisionSeam: ordinary branch choice before the exact LIVE-to-DEAD causal commitment
smallestProbe.advanceIf: Independent parents reproduce the same bounded semantic-family distinction under frozen fields, earning a smallest consumer falsifier.
smallestProbe.stopIf: The one-parent interface fails to recur or recurrence has no decision-bearing discordance.

rows.notes: This is intentionally EXTENSION rather than INVENTION until independent-parent replication shows a recurrent decision-bearing relation. No repair operator is earned.
